st: Against AI's endless permutations: scars and poetry?

sec.p: I won't hide it: I started writing this newsletter to collect news and ideas, to raise awareness of the futuro fortissimo that awaits us.
So, writing this newsletter, I'm avoiding dictating out loud or generating text with GPT.

sec.t: ff.146.3 The silence of the innocents
sec.p: On closer inspection, Calvino himself cast man as a parrot-automaton who rephrases things “standing on the shoulders of giants”.
Another way to save mankind might be illness. And all the suffering - the pathos - of our bodies.

rel: ff.18 Between digital art and AI
